Design Notes — Identity Lock

  • Crimson-red hair, yellow eyes — never orange, never gold eyes.
  • Black ridged horns + pointed ears; pale skin.
  • Black/indigo kimono over black hakama, silver clover crest, red sash, black neck cord with a gourd bead; katana with a silver SKULL pommel, ALWAYS sheathed — never drawn.
  • Keep the reference's soft dreamy glow, bloom and painterly finish — never flat studio.
  • Pure Edo fantasy; no modern tech.
  • Height 185 cm — the ruler (STYLE_BIBLE_v3 §Scale height chart). Pinned from canon: "Tall as a gate; broad shoulders, straight back, a heavy stride". In any shot with another character, state the pair relation against Genki 185 cm.
